During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bosph/Legends|Bosph]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] was '''blockaded''' and quarantined by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. The blockade was put in place after [[The galaxy/Legends|Galactic]] [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] became aware of the fact that planet's [[Bosph (species)|Bosph]] [[Species/Legends|species]] were controlled by a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Bosph government|government]]. The blockade began shortly before the [[Bombardment of Bosph/Legends|bombardment of Bosph]] and both events were orchestrated by the sector's [[Moff/Legends|Moff]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Harsh]]. Those few Bosphs who survived the orbital bombardment of the planet were almost all kept on their devastated [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] by the bombardment although a few did escape. All Bosphs, including those trapped, took up a policy of dis-remembrance toward the Empire meaning they refused to acknowledge it's existence, including the existence of the blockade.
